mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering a negative S&P 500 return over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 580 and RSAFS < 350000, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary policy easing and fiscal stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals strengthening economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market discounts improved business conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts decline below 580 thousand units indicates a weakening real estate market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to reduced construction activity and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 580, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signal persistent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate profitability and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 215 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During recessionary regimes (GDPC1 growth < 0.0% year-over-year), the market anticipates government stimulus and monetary easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a policy response.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth is negative, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
